import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { changesets } from "../../../backend/schema/changesets";

export const changesetsCms = customizeTable<typeof changesets>("changesets", {
    listFields: ["id", "closedAt", "minLat", "maxLat", "minLon", "maxLon"],
    fieldOrder: [
        "id",
        "closedAt",
        "minLat",
        "maxLat",
        "minLon",
        "maxLon",
        "numChanges",
        "numCreatedNodes",
        "numModifiedNodes",
        "numDeletedNodes",
        "numCreatedWays",
        "numModifiedWays",
        "numDeletedWays",
        "numCreatedRelations",
        "numModifiedRelations",
        "numDeletedRelations",
        "user",
        "createdAt"
    ]
});
